narr: A cluster of heavy rain producing thunderstorms along and near a surface low and cold frontal boundary resulted in numerous road closures and roads being washed out on September 13, 2023. Flooding was mostly concentrated within the towns of Washington and Roxbury.
ev: A portion of Judds Bridge Road was washed out near Roxbury due to flash flooding.
Several inches of water was reported over roadways near Chruch Hill Road and Popple Swamp Road per videos on social media.
Water washed out portions of Welton Road near Roxbury.
Water was reported over Booth Road with a portion washed out near Roxbury.
Several inches of water was reported over Route 199.
A portion of Tunnel Road was washed out due to flash flooding near Roxbury.
Water washed out portions of Grassy Hill Road near Roxbury.
A portion of Ranney Hill Road was washed out near Roxbury.
A portion of Mine Hill Road near Roxbury was washed out due to flash flooding.
Rain washed out portions of Botsford Hill Road in Roxbury. A stonewall also washed out onto the road.
Bacon Road was closed due to water over the road.
A portion of Hemlock Road washed out over Fenn Brook near Roxbury.
